faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers for the common parts of buying, installing and managing a travel eSIM.

questions.q1: When should I install my eSIM?
questions.a1: Install it before you travel when practical. Depending on the package, validity may start on installation, first connection, or first use; check the plan details you receive.
questions.q2: Can I keep my normal SIM active?
questions.a2: Usually yes. You can keep your primary line for calls/SMS and select the eSIM for mobile data. Be careful with data roaming on the primary line to avoid unexpected charges.
questions.q3: How do I check my data usage?
questions.a3: Open My eSIMs, select the order, then use Check usage. Some operators do not expose real-time usage through the provider API.
questions.q4: Can I top up an eSIM?
questions.a4: Only compatible operators/packages can be topped up. Open the eSIM details page and choose Top up data when compatible options are available.
questions.q5: What if I lose my QR code?
questions.a5: Open My eSIMs and your completed order again. Your activation details are retained there when the provider returns them.
questions.q6: What happens if a plan needs ID verification?
questions.a6: The order stays processing and a verification link is shown when the provider returns one. Complete verification before the eSIM can finish activation.
questions.q7: Can I buy an eSIM for someone else?
questions.a7: Yes. Use the recipient's email during checkout so the delivery information goes to them, or share the QR/install details securely after purchase.
